mapper.select: -- 메인 정보 조회 -- SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS MAIN_IMG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS MAIN_TEXT FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND C_BIG_CD = '10' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD

-- 개발자 정보 조회 -- SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_NM, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_PART, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '003' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_IMG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '004' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_TEXT, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '005' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_MSG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '006' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_TAG FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND C_BIG_CD = '20' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD

-- 연락처 정보 조회 -- SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_MAIL, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_CALL, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '003' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_TALK FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND C_BIG_CD = '30' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD
